author: Retvest

payload.name: Brief and review
payload.description: Draft a briefing, then review its assumptions in a second model step.

nodes.name: Draft briefing
nodes.template:
Write a concise briefing from the following user-provided material. Do not invent sources or claims. Identify missing information. Material:
{{input}}

nodes.name: Review assumptions
nodes.template:
Review this draft for unsupported claims, unclear reasoning and missing assumptions. Return a revised brief followed by a short list of unresolved questions. Do not invent source evidence. Draft:
{{steps.draft}}
